subject: Foreign vendor GST registration, delegation and PO acknowledgement flow
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <priya@brightpack.co>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@brightpack.co>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: GST registration / PO acknowledgement — BrightPack (AU/NZ)

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking this on. We are BrightPack Logistics — registered in Australia and supply services to Redwood in AU and NZ. Accounts here — Olga and I — have a couple of items to confirm before we can be fully onboarded into your PO flow:

1) GST / Tax setup for AU & NZ: we are registered for Australian GST (ABN attached) but do not have a separate NZ GST registration. Can Redwood accept invoices with Australian GST for NZ-sourced services, or do we need local registration in NZ?

2) Fiscal representative / delegated invoicing: for a small number of clients we use a fiscal rep for local tax filings. If Redwood requires a local fiscal rep for NZ, what documentation is needed?

3) PO acknowledgement: when Redwood issues a PO will you accept a counter-signed PO as confirmation, or do you require a separate vendor portal acceptance?

4) Payment / bank details and remittance: sending bank details (attached) — please confirm routing for cross-border payments and whether Redwood requires any specific invoice fields for GST reclaim.

I've attached: BrightPack_GST_Registration_AU.pdf and BrightPack_bank_details.pdf.

Would appreciate a quick checklist and next steps so we can close this out this week.

Best,
Priya Sharma
Head of Finance
BrightPack Logistics
priya@brightpack.co

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodai.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@brightpack.co>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodai.com, irene_choi@redwoodai.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 12:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: GST registration / PO acknowledgement — BrightPack (AU/NZ)

Hi Priya — thanks for the details and the attachments. Quick response and plan below so we have a single checklist: 

Summary of what we need and proposed approach:

- AU invoices for AU services: fine as-is with Australian GST (we will remit to APAC accounting).
- NZ supplies: Redwood prefers the vendor to provide an NZ GST ID but can accept reverse-charge where law permits. Tax/compliance (Irene) to confirm whether we can apply reverse charge for the services you provide to Redwood NZ.
- Fiscal representative: if you plan to use a fiscal rep for NZ filings, send the agency letter of authorization and the fiscal rep’s local registration details. That will let our tax team accept invoices from the fiscal rep on your behalf.
- PO acknowledgement: we can accept a counter-signed PO (pdf) or a portal acknowledgement — either is fine. If you counter-sign, please include the vendor legal entity name exactly as on your tax docs.
- Invoice fields: please include full ABN/registration, invoice currency, GST line, and a short service description with the PO number. For cross-border payments include IBAN/Swift and indicate whether there will be any intermediary bank charges.

Next actions (who does what):
- Priya/Olga: send agency letter if using fiscal rep; confirm whether NZ services are supplied out of AU or if you will register in NZ.
- Irene (tax & compliance): confirm reverse-charge acceptance and required evidence for our APAC tax filing.
- Laura (vendor ops): will confirm onboarding steps for PO acceptance and how to stamp the vendor record so that PO BR-12345 maps to your ABN.

Irene, Laura — looping you in to advise and take action. Priya — if you send the fiscal rep letter and confirm the NZ position, I’ll fast-track the PO acknowledgement.

Attaching a short PO checklist template for vendors (PO_CHECKLIST.txt) — I will upload the signed PO after we confirm the vendor legal name you want on the document.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodai.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodai.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@brightpack.co>
Cc: irene_choi@redwoodai.com, ben_carter@redwoodai.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: GST registration / PO acknowledgement — BrightPack (AU/NZ)

Thanks Marcus / Priya — quick vendor-ops note and what we'll require to onboard the vendor record and issue PO BR-12345:

Required items from BrightPack (we can proceed once we have these):
- Scanned copy of company registration (ABN verification) — we have BrightPack_GST_Registration_AU.pdf, OK.
- Signed vendor setup form (attached in this thread as VENDOR_SETUP_FORM.pdf) — please fill legal name, remit address, tax ID (ABN), contact for invoice questions.
- If using fiscal rep in NZ: agency letter or power of attorney naming the rep and scope + rep’s local tax ID.
- Bank details: BrightPack_bank_details.pdf received. Please confirm whether beneficiary name matches legal entity for ACH/SWIFT.

PO process notes: 
- We will create PO BR-12345 and email a PDF. You may either countersign (return PDF with signature) or click Accept in our vendor portal (link below). A countersigned PO will be considered an acknowledgement and triggers scheduled payments per the PO payment terms.
- If invoices include AU GST for NZ services and you are not registered in NZ, we need a short explanation on the invoice (e.g., "Supplied from AU — GST charged under AU law") and a note on whether you intend to register in NZ within 90 days. Otherwise tax will flag and hold payments pending clarification.

Action items for Priya / Olga: please complete the attached vendor setup form and return signed copy + fiscal rep letter (if applicable). If you prefer us to draft the PO with your preferred payee name, state the exact legal name to use.

Portal: https://redwood-inference.app/vendor-portal/brightpack

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodai.com
Attachment: VENDOR_SETUP_FORM.pdf (please fill and return)

We will countersign the PO once you issue BR-12345. Please proceed to generate the PO with legal name "BrightPack Logistics Pty Ltd".
